steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: 'Emancipation of Expressionism' was choreographed by Kenrick H2O Sandy for Boy Blue Entertainment and premiered in 2017 | Key Fact: Boy Blue Entertainment is a hip-hop dance company founded by Kenrick H2O Sandy and Michael Asante | Key Fact: The choreographic intention is to demonstrate the power of expression through hip-hop dance and show how movement can communicate freedom | Key Fact: The stimulus was the concept of emancipation — liberation through expressive movement — and the role of hip-hop as an art form for self-expression
